prompt:
Create one standalone photorealistic photo for a personal gift website. A 41-year-old author with short salt-and-pepper hair, a clean-shaven face and round glasses opens a cardboard box containing the first printed copies of his own book. He lifts one book with a pleased, disbelieving smile in a modest study. Covers are solid muted terracotta and completely blank. Use soft side light, believable cardboard folds and separate natural fingers supporting the book. Refined warm lifestyle editorial photography with considered light and relaxed expressions. Square 1:1 gallery composition, with comfortable room around faces, hands and the complete action. Invent ordinary fictional people with distinct faces, realistic skin and believable age. Use warm paper, muted terracotta and natural surrounding colours without heavy filtering. Preserve correct anatomy, fingers, limbs and object geometry. One continuous real photograph: no fade, gradient mask, crossfade, compositing or synthetic caption band. No readable words, numbers, logos, watermarks, borders, collages or grids.
Native image aspect ratio exactly 1:1. The book cover, back and spine are blank flat colour, with no lettering, symbols or decorative marks.
review: Square first-book-printing scene shows the author lifting a blank terracotta hardcover from a cardboard carton. Main book has coherent edges and page block; separate fingers support its sides and base naturally. Covers and visible main spine have no text; face and whole unboxing action are framed. Lower scene is continuous cardboard and table.
